protocol: prereg step 4: proposals pooled, provenance stripped, stable-sha256 order, FRESH independent Sonnet auditor sees ONLY round4_proposals_blinded.json; disputes with the proposing track adjudicated by a frontier (Opus) arbiter

final.name: "Framework" as the contribution noun
final.audit_justification: The instruction explicitly says to 'score the choice of noun only' — it tallies a lexical habit (framework vs. concrete object word) rather than evaluating the contribution itself.

final.name: Leaves a transferable design principle, not only a method
final.audit_justification: It requires judging whether a stated take-away is actually grounded in the reported results rather than merely asserted, which is a real evidentiary-support judgment.

final.name: Corrects a specific prior claim rather than adding to a pile
final.audit_justification: It asks the judge to determine whether there is an identifiable prior claim the paper actually corrects, which requires reading the contribution's epistemic content rather than counting a phrase.

final.name: Evaluation conditions match the conditions the claim is about
final.audit_justification: It requires judging external validity — whether the evaluation's conditions actually match the conditions the claim is made about — a genuine rigor question.

final.name: Necessity established — an ablation shows the components are actually required
final.audit_justification: It requires the judge to verify that a necessity claim is actually backed by an ablation, i.e. to assess evidentiary support rather than presence of a word.

final.name: Poses a specific question and states its answer plainly
final.audit_justification: The instruction explicitly says to score the question-and-answer structure, not the importance of the question, i.e. a rhetorical/document-shape feature.

arbiter.model: Opus (frontier arbiter; criterion text + auditor verdict + proposer rationale)
arbiter.reason: As written the closing clause ('Score the question-and-answer structure, not the importance of the question') strips out the only merit dimension, leaving an interrogative-frame-plus-declarative-resolution shape label that a trivial question answered plainly satisfies completely. It also mis-ranks the merit-equivalent case: an abstract asserting a sharp finding declaratively is maximally claim-bearing yet scores low for lacking Q-and-A shape, and penalising the strongest form of the underlying virtue is the signature of a document-shape feature. It is the already-declared rhetorical-questions nuisance (alone-AUC .5077) conjoined with an extra clause the instruction then subordinates to structure. Error direction matters: admitting a shape feature to the A bank inflates the articulated aggregation and shrinks the residual, manufacturing a false 'articulated it away', so nuisance is both conservative and correct. Falsifiability-based salvage rewrite supplied for round 5; it is a NEW criterion needing fresh scoring.

final.name: Passive-voice density
final.audit_justification: This is explicitly a grammatical-construction count (passive vs. active voice), pure surface style.

final.name: Scare-quoted or coined terms in quotation marks
final.audit_justification: This tallies a punctuation/quotation habit ('score the quotation habit only'), not any property of the research.

final.name: Multiplicative speedup notation
final.audit_justification: The instruction explicitly says to count the multiplicative-figure notation only and not judge whether the speedup is real or fair.

final.name: Bare mention of the word "ablation"
final.audit_justification: The instruction explicitly says to count the bare word 'ablation' and not judge whether any ablation was informative or supported a necessity claim — pure keyword tally, the adversarial pair to P05.

final.name: Checks whether a trivial approach would have sufficed
final.audit_justification: It requires the judge to check whether a real sanity-check comparison against a trivial/degenerate baseline was actually reported, a substantive rigor check.

final.name: Methodological critique — a flawed practice in the field is named AND its consequence shown
final.audit_justification: It requires both identifying a specific flawed practice and confirming a demonstrated consequence, i.e. judging evidence of a real methodological critique, not just its presence.

final.name: Simplicity restoration — a simple or classical method is shown to match or beat elaborate recent ones
final.audit_justification: It requires judging the actual simplicity of the proposed method against the actual elaborateness of what it beats, a substantive contrast rather than a keyword or genre tag.

final.name: Efficiency-vocabulary density
final.audit_justification: The instruction explicitly says to count the efficiency-register vocabulary only, not whether efficiency was actually achieved or measured.

final.name: Membership in the graph-learning / GNN subfield
final.audit_justification: This scores subfield/topic membership only and explicitly states work of any quality in another subfield scores 0 — a topic tag, not a merit.

final.name: Parenthetical example density
final.audit_justification: This tallies a punctuation habit (parenthetical asides), explicitly 'the parenthetical habit only'.

final.name: Cost accounting includes the method's own overhead
final.audit_justification: It requires verifying that a reported saving's accounting actually includes the method's own overhead, a substantive honesty/rigor check on the claimed result.

final.name: Reports the number a skeptic would ask for
final.audit_justification: It requires judging whether the abstract volunteers the specific unflattering quantity that would undercut its own claim, a substantive honesty-in-reporting judgment.

final.name: Includes a condition under which the method is expected to do badly
final.audit_justification: It requires checking whether the evaluation includes a deliberately adversarial or hard condition rather than only favorable settings, a genuine rigor/stress-testing check.

final.name: Unification — one mechanism handles problems previously treated separately
final.audit_justification: It requires judging both how many genuinely distinct problems are addressed and how unified the mechanism is, a substantive parsimony/scope assessment rather than a label count.

final.name: Self-referential discourse markers
final.audit_justification: This counts boilerplate self-referential phrases ('In this paper', 'Here we'), explicitly 'the self-reference only'.

final.name: The motivating observation is itself reported as a finding
final.audit_justification: It requires judging whether a motivating observation is presented as something the authors actually established versus merely assumed or cited, an evidentiary-honesty distinction.

final.name: Reports variability across seeds, splits, or runs
final.audit_justification: It checks for a real empirical practice — stability checks across seeds/splits/runs, including reporting instability — that bears on the trustworthiness of the results.

final.name: Mathematical symbols embedded in the method's own name
final.audit_justification: The instruction explicitly frames this as 'naming style only' — whether the method's name contains symbols, unrelated to research substance.

final.name: Credits what prior work got right while stating what it missed
final.audit_justification: It requires confirming both a genuine acknowledged contribution of prior work and a specific stated gap, a substantive fair-engagement-with-literature judgment.
